newsitem.title: GREECE: Ionian Securities speaks out on Delta scandal.
newsitem.headline: Ionian Securities speaks out on Delta scandal.

text.p: Ionian Securities, a subsidiary of state Ionian Bank said in a statement that it signed the broker association's (SMEHA) proposals aiming at contributing speedier transparency procedures at the bourse.

"Our company does not owe the clearing house today and has not owed in the past either securities or cash. On the contrary, the clearing house owes Ionian Securities funds dating from November 7 -- when the bourse halted trade," it said.
Ionian Securities was one of the 10 Athens stock exchange member firms ordered audited by Athens bourse supervisor George Malakis on Tuesday.
Most members of the Athens brokers association (SMEHA) have been boycotting trade at bourse, effectively closing the exchange, since one firm, Delta Securities, was charged with fraud last week.
Delta is accused of trying to pay 2.6 billion drachmas of settlements with bad cheques.
SMEHA members have demanded that the government take action to make sure the bourse clearing house functions properly in future and that settlements are guaranteed.
